title: Calibrated time-domain pair ranking for strongly lensed gravitational waves
description: Code, frozen model checkpoints, source and pair manifests, per-pair prediction scores, and statistical artifacts for calibrated pair verification of strongly lensed gravitational waves. Version 2.0 supersedes v1.0: the CQT--DeiT baseline was retrained on a rebuilt training pair set after an audit found that the original negatives crossed the train/validation split, and twenty additional training instances were added for the instance-variability study. PI-ResNet is unchanged.
